title: Southeast Fisheries Management History Data
text: Fisheries management history data essential properly understanding trends fishery-dependent data well results stock assessment models. Federal regulations published Federal Registrar (FR) notices. Southeast US region Southeast Data Assessment Review (SEDAR) process, management histories upcoming stock assessment previously provided species species basis, often lacked consistent documentation FR notice rule published. standardize collection data, Southeast Fisheries Management History Database built populated Federal Management Plans (FMPs) throughout Gulf America, South Atlantic, U.S. Caribbean regions. Compilation database collaborative process involving South Atlantic Fishery Management Council (SAFMC), Gulf Fishery Management Council (GFMC), Southeast Regional Office (SERO), Southeast Fisheries Science Center (SEFSC) personnel. Funding project, beginning 2020, made possible NOAA’s Fisheries Information System (FIS) program. total, FRs 16 FMPs entered Southeast region. record within database contains regulation FR notice, however unprocessed format, individual management actions disjointed rule often overwrites changes existing rule. FishHist package provides analysis-ready Fisheries Management History dataset links reconciles overlapping regulatory actions time. Built-functions support visualizing analyzing data scientific research management.
